title: Jets rookie QB Cade Klubnik impresses in preseason debut: 'Today was really a thumbs-up for him'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets rookie QB Cade Klubnik impresses in preseason debut: 'Today was really a thumbs-up for him'
sources.description: Rookie QB Cade Klubnik started Friday's preseason opener for the Jets and impressed, leading two scoring drives and converting most of his passes.
